en.title: Largest Square Area in Cityscape
en.description:
You are given an array of non-negative building heights. Find the largest area of a square that fits beneath a contiguous run of buildings; side s is feasible if and only if there are s consecutive buildings each with height at least s. This criterion corresponds to the explicit condition in the source's solution section.

Rules follow the original OAMaster problem; the input/output protocol and bounds marked "site-added" were compiled by this site.
en.input: n (1≤n≤200000), n heights h (0≤h≤10^9); the ranges are site-added.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for details.
